description: This header file defines the RustAdapter class, which implements the IPlugin interface for integrating Rust plugins within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes configuration management, lifecycle methods, and interfacing with the plugin host, along with relevant includes and namespace organization.

classes.name: RustAdapter
classes.description: A plugin class implementing the IPlugin interface, serving as a bridge between WPEFramework and Rust plugins, managing plugin lifecycle, configuration, and communication.

classes.name: RustAdapter::Config
classes.description: A configuration class holding parameters for the RustAdapter, such as address, port, and library name, serialized/deserialized as JSON.

methods.name: RustAdapter
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the RustAdapter instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the shell, returning a status message.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, performing necessary cleanup.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a string describing the plugin status or info.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for plugin lifetime management.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count, possibly leading to cleanup.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin in the provided shell context.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a communication channel to the plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a communication channel from the plugin.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token, method, and parameters combination.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles invocation requests, with different signatures depending on version/configuration.
